description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and copiers for the SortedList<TKey, TValue> type in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines how SortedList instances are serialized, deserialized, and deep-copied within Orleans.

classes.name: SortedListCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for SortedList, handling conversion to and from surrogate form.

classes.name: SortedListSurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate data structure used during serialization of SortedList.

classes.name: SortedListCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Implements deep copying logic for SortedList instances.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Constructs a SortedList from its surrogate representation.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Creates a surrogate representation from a SortedList.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedList.
